desc:
Do you enjoy stunning cutscenes and storylines, obb-like games and parkour, or fights with monsters and bosses? Then "Mega School Escape!" is the game for you.

This is the story of how you get stuck in a school full of angry teachers. Can you avoid all the dangers and escape?

Features of this game:
- Entertaining parkour
- Interaction - switches, levers, buttons, and clickable objects
- Game map you can use to teleport. Saves your progress!
- Numerous enemies - ranged, jumping, and even self-exploding
- Epic boss fights
- Stunning cutscenes
